summary: 10 film announcements, 11 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Naughty
film.talent: Jennifer Aniston, Peter Dinklage; Director: Olivia Wilde
film.announcement: Jennifer Aniston and Peter Dinklage set to star in Olivia Wilde's Santa Claus comedy with a 2027 release date from Universal and LuckyChap Entertainment.

film.title: Elsinore
film.announcement: Focus Features acquires the film Elsinore starring Andrew Scott and Olivia Colman, set for a November fall release.

film.title: Behemoth!
film.announcement: Tony Gilroy's Behemoth! starring Pedro Pascal set to world premiere as the New York Film Festival Centerpiece selection.

film.title: American Fever Dream
film.talent: Alexandra Daddario, Christopher Convery, Julian Morris, Spenser Granese
film.announcement: Alexandra Daddario toplines indie drama American Fever Dream alongside Christopher Convery, Julian Morris, and Spenser Granese.

film.title: Unrequited
film.announcement: Shabana Azeez from The Pitt set for queer romance film Unrequited.

film.title: Limbo, U.S.A
film.announcement: Reed Birney joins Turkish star Sercan Badur in New York-set LGBT romantic drama Limbo, U.S.A.

film.title: Disconnecting Peter
film.announcement: Lena Hall from Your Friends & Neighbors joins Chad Michael Murray in film Disconnecting Peter.

film.title: Children of Blood and Bone
film.announcement: Trailer released for film adaptation of Tomi Adeyemi's bestselling novel Children of Blood and Bone featuring an all-star cast.

film.title: Nosotros
film.announcement: FiGa Films snags worldwide rights to Guatemalan drama Nosotros ahead of its Toronto International Film Festival premiere.

film.title: NDA
film.announcement: Carson Rowland from Sweet Magnolias joins Rachel Zegler in film NDA.

tv.title: Warhammer 40,000
tv.talent: Henry Cavill; Executive Producer: Mike Flanagan
tv.announcement: Mike Flanagan in talks to executive produce Amazon MGM Studios' Warhammer 40,000 TV series starring Henry Cavill.

tv.title: Untitled Marriage Comedy
tv.talent: Creator: Atsuko Okatsuka, Josh Rabinowitz; Executive Producers: Hiro Murai, Ramy Youssef
tv.announcement: Amazon developing half-hour marriage comedy from Atsuko Okatsuka and Josh Rabinowitz with Hiro Murai and Ramy Youssef among executive producers.

tv.title: Beauty in Black
tv.announcement: Tyler Perry's Beauty in Black sets Season 3 premiere date and releases first-look photos.

tv.title: Detective Agent Derek
tv.talent: Creator: Nick Kreiss; Production: Big Grey Mass
tv.announcement: Hulu buys animated TV comedy pitch Detective Agent Derek from Nick Kreiss and Trio Big Grey Mass.

tv.title: Memory of a Killer
tv.announcement: Meta Golding joins Memory of a Killer as Season 2 series regular, playing someone from Angelo's past.

tv.title: The Line
tv.announcement: Food Network sets new Bobby Flay restaurant-dining competition series The Line for fall debut.

tv.title: Biological War
tv.talent: Production: Patrick Macmanus' Littleton Road Productions
tv.announcement: TV adaptation of Biological War in development at Universal Global Television and Patrick Macmanus' Littleton Road Productions.

tv.title: Art Detectives
tv.announcement: Art Detectives starring Stephen Moyer renewed for Season 2 at Acorn TV.

tv.title: This Is a Game Show
tv.talent: Mitsy Sanderson; Production: Adam Wescott's Home Game Studios
tv.announcement: Mitsy Sanderson sets Tubi series This Is a Game Show from Adam Wescott's newly launched Home Game Studios.

tv.title: Babylon Berlin
tv.announcement: Babylon Berlin sets finale date and unveils video game, documentary, and audio spinoffs.

tv.title: Gallus
tv.announcement: Scottish stand-up Connor Burns sets Gorilla Comedy+ launch for new special Gallus.
